name: Isle of Man
summary_text: Isle of Man: Crown Dependency, own parliament: own Gender Recognition Act (2009) and Equality Act (2017) protect gender reassignment; neither the EHRC code nor the England/Wales prison regime extends here; no local gender-care pathway (residents travel to the UK). Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of +0.14. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Judge rules Scottish guidance for housing trans prisoners is unlawful - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about Scotland's prison policy for trans prisoners (June 2026 ruling), not the Isle of Man; included as UK-context material (the Isle of Man is a Crown Dependency).

sources.title: Suicide risk if trans prisoners are put in jails based on sex at birth, court told - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about the same Scottish prison-housing litigation (Feb 2026), not the Isle of Man; included as UK-context material only.

Tynwald Hansard (26 April 2016): Legislative Council proceedings - Third Reading of the Marriage and Civil Partnership (Amendment) Bill 2016 (same-sex marriage) and consideration of the Equality Bill 2016 - the primary legislative record of the Isle of Man's marriage-equality debate.

sources.title: First same-sex marriage conversion on Isle of Man 'huge milestone' - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (July 2016): first same-sex marriage conversion on the Isle of Man - Marc and Alan Steffan-Cowell converted their civil partnership to marriage, keeping their original 2015 wedding date; same-sex marriage became legal after Royal Assent to the Marriage and Civil Partnership Act.

sources.title: BBC NEWS | World | Europe | Isle of Man | Gay employment rights are adopted
sources.claim_summary: BBC News (Nov 2005): the House of Keys adopted a clause protecting employees from dismissal on grounds of sexual orientation - an amendment to the Employment Bill, done proactively 'in line with human rights legislation'.

sources.title: Chief Minister looks to legalise same-sex marriage - 3FM Isle of Man
sources.claim_summary: 3FM (June 2015): Chief Minister Allan Bell announced he believes in same-sex marriage and would formulate a bill to scrap prohibitive legislation, discussing it with the Bishop of Sodor and Man - at the time Tynwald and Northern Ireland were the only British powers not allowing LGBT people to wed.
